title: Recorded openEMS pulse through a two-floor house
derivation: Every second x and z sample of the recorded vertical Ey cut. All 143 original timestamps retained, with unchanged float32 fields. No temporal thinning, interpolation, quantization or recalculation.
field_order: point,time; point ordering is StructuredGrid/Fortran order
normalization: Unchanged recorded Ey(t) in V/m for the common unit Gaussian lumped-port drive; no division by a single-frequency spectrum. No temporal interpolation, padding or phase reconstruction.
reference_description: Shared air reference outside a 0.2 m source radius; FD and TD use separate physical normalizations and references.
limitations: Compact schematic two-level structure; homogeneous isotropic partitions and timber slabs, no glazing, furniture, reinforcement or measured construction. A floor opening represents a stairwell void; no stairs are modeled. 500 MHz, not a Wi-Fi band. Only recorded slices are available. The 25 mm grid has not undergone a house-specific mesh convergence study; energy decay is not convergence validation. Ey is tangential to the inter-floor slab; normal field components at dielectric interfaces are affected by node interpolation. No claim of deployment or hardware accuracy.
